thread:
Clare (product): Quick heads-up — rolling out two related onprem updates this week: (1) a new "export assertion" bundle for customer compliance audits, and (2) an automated agent TLS cert rotation helper. Both tied to a telemetry opt-in change for new installs. Details below.

Matt (eng-infra): Nice. timeline?

Clare (product): Timeline: preview docs + internal alpha TOMORROW 09:00 PT, public docs + GA rollout next Tue (7 days). Preview will be enabled in staging and private-preview clusters only.

Sana (security): Short summary of the export bundle pls — what data goes out, format, and how we assert integrity?

Clare (product): Export assertion bundle = compressed JSON + signed manifest. Contains config (redacted secrets), local audit logs (last 90d), installed package versions, and attestation metadata. Nothing leaves the customer by default — customer triggers export or we generate a signed bundle for them during audits. We sign manifest with our PKI so they can verify it came from a Redwood operator.

Jordan (ops): For signed manifests, do we depend on our central KMS? If so, we need fallback for air-gapped customers.

Matt (eng-infra): Good catch. Implementation: for hosted/private-controlplane customers we use central KMS signing. For airgapped/onprem-only customers there's a local-signing mode that uses a customer-managed key (CMSK) stored in their HSM or provided via a file. Docs will show both flows.

Sana (security): Please include the threat model in the preview doc — tamper evidence, replay protection, and verification steps. Also need rotation guidance.

Clare (product): Agreed — will add threat model & verification commands.

Emily (support): Support playbook note: when customers request an assertion bundle, support should validate the manifest signature and checksum before handing it off. I'll draft a runbook if someone posts the verification CLI.

Matt (eng-infra): Agent TLS cert rotation helper: a small tool shipped with agent v3.2 that rotates the agent cert + updates local trust store. It produces a dry-run log first. CLI: `redwood-agent rotate-cert --dry-run --out ./rotation-log.json` and `redwood-agent rotate-cert --apply --key /path/to/customer.key`.

Priya (solutions): Will SEs get RBAC to trigger bundles on behalf of customers? Some customers expect us to produce the bundle as part of their audit support contract.

Clare (product): Yes — new operator role `bundle:export` gated by account-level consent. SEs will have a temporary scoped token flow. We'll add the consent audit record to the bundle metadata.

Ben (sales): Heads-up for AE team: this feature is a strong selling point for compliance-heavy prospects. I'll add a short blurb to the playbook. Any one-pager we can use?

Clare (product): I'll drop a 1-pager in the sales drive by EOD with sample manifest and verification steps.

Sana (security): On the telemetry opt-in change: what's changing?

Clare (product): New installs of onprem agent will default telemetry to OFF (opt-in). Existing installs are unchanged. Rationale: enterprise/regulatory asks and parity with private installs. We'll surface a clear prompt during agent install, and require an explicit flag `--telemetry=enable` for automated installs.

Jordan (ops): Any impact on our monitoring or alerting pipelines? Need to know if some internal debug hooks stop sending data.

Matt (eng-infra): No impact to internal telemetry when customers opt-out. We already have separate channels for customer telemetry vs product-dev metrics. Only customer-facing telemetry is affected.

Emily (support): Will this affect our ability to triage incidents? If so, add a recommended local debug procedure to the runbook.

Clare (product): Good call — include a section on local log collection and how customers can produce temporary opt-in bundles for troubleshooting.

Sana (security): Compliance reminder: for airgapped customers, do not suggest any automated upload. Everything must be manual/export-only.

Clare (product): Correct — export bundle generation is offline for airgapped, signed locally, and transferred by customer.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: docs-preview on staging scheduled 2026-03-25 09:00 PT (job id db-4221).

Matt (eng-infra): Will the rotation helper require a rolling restart of the agent? If yes, include a low-impact mode.

Clare (product): Rotation helper supports `--no-restart` that hot-reloads certs where supported; fallback runs a single-process restart. We'll document which OS/runtime combinations support hot reload.

Ben (sales): Any regulatory cert we should mention explicitly in the one-pager? FedRAMP / SOC2 / ISO?

Sana (security): Mention SOC2 and ISO27001 for now. FedRAMP customers will need a tailored flow — we'll route those requests to the compliance team.

Priya (solutions): Request: include sample customer affidavit text they can put in their audit portal to assert bundle provenance.

Clare (product): Will do. Action items: (1) docs preview link when available — @Matt to confirm staging toggle, (2) @Sana to add threat model + verification steps, (3) @Emily to draft support runbook, (4) @Priya/@Ben to review sales/SE collateral. I'll post the docs link here when the deploy finishes. Thanks all. :rocket:
